Phase 3 (part 1/2) is complete. Both files were already present with correct implementations. I made one fix: added the `startDate <= endDate` refinement to `updateLeaveRequestSchema` to enforce the date invariant on update paths as well.

**Files created/updated:**

1. **`src/modules/leave-request/leave-request.model.ts`** — Contains:
   - `LeaveRequest` entity interface with all canonical fields
   - `CreateLeaveRequestDto` with employeeId, leaveType, startDate, endDate, optional reason
   - `LeaveRequestNotFoundError` and `LeaveRequestValidationError` error classes (following the `BalanceNotFoundError` pattern: extend `Error`, readonly `code`, set `this.name`)
   - `createLeaveRequestSchema` (Zod) with `.refine()` enforcing `startDate <= endDate`
   - `updateLeaveRequestSchema` (Zod) with `.refine()` enforcing `startDate <= endDate` when both dates are provided
   - `ILeaveRequestRepository` interface with all required methods including `updateStatus` with documented state transitions
   - `ILeaveRequestService` interface with all required methods and documented error contracts

2. **`src/modules/notification/notification.model.ts`** — Contains:
   - `Notification` entity interface with exactly the authoritative fields (id, recipientId, type, title, message, relatedEntityType, relatedEntityId, status, createdAt, readAt)
   - `INotificationRepository` interface with all required methods
   - `INotificationService` interface with all notify* methods, getNotifications, and markAsRead

**Verification:**
- `npm run build` (tsc --noEmit) — passes with zero errors
- `npx jest --passWithNoTests` — all 70 existing tests pass
- All enums imported from `src/shared/types/index.ts`
- No `any` types, no direct DB access, no hardcoded secrets, no @gestalt/* deps
- Cross-module imports follow architecture: notification → leave-request (type-only import)
